label: Projectile
desc: Fires projectiles at the closest enemy.

label: Explosive orb
desc: Throws an orb that explodes on impact.

label: Bomb
desc: Lobs a bomb in an arc that explodes in an area.

label: Burst
desc: Fires a rapid burst of projectiles.

label: Homing
desc: Projectiles that chase their targets. They never miss.

label: Bolt
desc: Fires a continuous beam that pierces everything.

label: Cone
desc: Fires a cone-shaped torrent in front of you.

label: Shockwave
desc: Releases a wave that hits everything around you.

label: Aura
desc: An aura that continuously damages nearby enemies.

label: Orbit
desc: Items that spin around you hitting enemies.

label: Strike
desc: An arcing strike against the closest enemy.

label: Charge
desc: A charge that sweeps through in a straight line.

label: Chain
desc: Hits an enemy and jumps to other nearby ones.

label: Heavenly Impact
desc: Strikes fall from the sky on nearby enemies.

label: Meteor
desc: Summons a devastating meteor after a moment.

label: Boomerang
desc: Throws something that goes out and comes back, piercing enemies.

label: Trap
desc: Lays traps that explode on contact.

label: Vortex
desc: A whirlwind that pulls in enemies and then explodes.

label: Wave
desc: A wide wave that sweeps everything in its path.

label: Trail
desc: You leave a damaging trail as you move.

label: Drain
desc: Projectiles that steal life on impact.

label: Spin
desc: You spin, hitting and pushing everyone around you.

label: Weather
desc: Changes the weather: boosts certain types.

label: Booster
desc: Temporarily powers you up.

label: Random
desc: Every few seconds it turns into a random attack from the League, with its upgrades.

label: Fusion
desc: Two moves fused in Bill's Machine.
